description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The snapshot IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

descriptions.en: If the IDs of the snapshots that you specify do not exist, requests are ignored.
